description: This file defines a class HierarchyTreeBuilder that provides a builder pattern to construct HierarchyTreeNode objects with various properties and methods for setting attributes.

classes.name: HierarchyTreeBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing HierarchyTreeNode objects with fluent interface methods.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the node being built.

methods.name: setKind
methods.description: Sets the kind (type/category) of the node.

methods.name: setStableId
methods.description: Sets the stable ID of the node.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the node.

methods.name: setShortName
methods.description: Sets an optional short name for the node.

methods.name: setChips
methods.description: Sets the chips associated with the node.

methods.name: setDiffType
methods.description: Sets the difference type for the node.

methods.name: setChildren
methods.description: Sets the child nodes for the node.

methods.name: setDisplayId
methods.description: Sets the display ID for the node.

methods.name: setVisibleView
methods.description: Sets whether the node shows in only visible view.

methods.name: setFilteredView
methods.description: Sets whether the node is shown in filtered view.

methods.name: setSimplifyNames
methods.description: Sets the flag for simplifying names.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a HierarchyTreeNode instance with the configured properties.

ctags.name: node
ctags.pattern: /^    const node = new HierarchyTreeNode(this.name, this.kind, this.stableId, this.children);$/
